bio: With Feast, Donaat and Guy have created a vintage-style haven where you come to relax and enjoy yourself. The presence of record players makes it clear that music is central to the experience here and you can even customise the background music with your own records. The menu features a variety of international dishes presented in tapas-sized portions. Think smörrebröd topped with scallops and kohlrabi, or oven-baked leek with a satay sauce – playful and packed with flavour, without a hint of pretentiousness. With a wide range of natural wines and well-known favourites, the wine list has plenty of gems in store....
